deals.description: We’re heading to the Austrian-American Friendship Fest! 🇦🇹🇺🇸 We are thrilled to announce that Smarthlete is joining Fulbright Austria at TU Wien on Saturday, September 26 for a full day celebrating sports, culture, and innovation! ⚽️ Heading out for Tag des Sports in Vienna this Saturday? Make a full sports day out of it! We're just around the corner at Karlsplatz—pop over to catch our sessions and meet the team! Here is what we have lined up for you at our setup: 📍 Our Booth: Stop by our stand in the exhibition area to meet the team, connect, and learn all about the U.S. college sports recruiting process! 🎤 Master Classes: We’re taking the stage for interactive sports workshops, expert presentation sessions, and direct Q&A! Whether you’re an athlete, coach, sports enthusiast, or student, drop by to say hello—the entire festival features food trucks, live stages, and sports activities, and it’s 100% free and open to the public! 🗓 Saturday, Sept 26, 2026 ⏰ 10:00 – 18:00 📍 TU Wien (Karlsplatz 13, 1040 Vienna) 🎟 Free Admission #AustrianAmericanFriendshipFest #FulbrightAustria #Smarthlete #TagDesSports2026 #ViennaEvents
